preconditions.description: The number of workers n is between 1 and 5000 inclusive.
The numerator a and denominator b satisfy 1 <= a <= b <= 10^5.
The string s has length exactly n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c not in 'trygub' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s does not contain the characters 't', 'r', 'y', 'g', 'u', or 'b'.

postconditions.description: The output consists of an integer c followed by exactly c space-separated characters.
The output characters are sorted in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: k = a / b; obtainable = {char for char in set(s) if can_obtain_all(char, s, k)}; set(stdout.split()[1:]) == obtainable
postconditions.description: The set of output characters is exactly the set of job categories that can be made the sole category of all workers via the defined operations, where a category x is obtainable if there exists a sequence of valid operations transforming the initial string s into a string consisting entirely of x. An operation on category x is valid if k * (max_pos - min_pos + 1) <= count, where min_pos and max_pos are the first and last positions of x, and count is the number of occurrences of x.
